AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

 "doc": "Indonesian word lists for the story analyzer (scripts/analyze.mjs + scripts/story-nlp.mjs). Keys are lowercase ROOTS or word forms (one or two words) — the analyzer strips affixes (me-/mem-/men-/meng-/meny-, ber-, ter-, di-, ke-, -kan, -i, -an, -nya, -lah), so a root covers every form (\"ambil\" = mengambil, mengambilnya, diambil). object values: a library object id, \"builtin:<id>\", \"prop:<id>\" (held prop), \"world:<thing>\" (built by the world itself: doors, windows, lamps), \"ui:<thing>\" (shown as a screen/card insert: a message, a photo, CCTV footage), \"look:<thing>\" (clothing / accessory on a person), \"generate:<english name>\" (author it from primitives) or \"complex:<english name>\" (too organic / detailed for primitives). actions: an engine action, \"face:<face>\" or \"unsupported:<what>\". states: what happens to a thing (on / off / sound / out / open / shut / buzz). sources: sound sources → SFX. figures: words for an unnamed (often uncanny) person. stop: words that are never names or objects.",
